items.title: CedarDB wants one database to handle both transactions and analytics, as AI agents raise the stakes
items.summary: Databases have traditionally been designed either for analytical data or for operational data. But database engine CedarDB supports both, and its approach has gained relevance with the rise of agentic AI.
items.creator: Anna Heim

items.title: Ambani’s Jio seeks to raise $3.2B in what could be India’s biggest IPO
items.summary: Jio plans to use most of its IPO proceeds to repay debt as it expands beyond telecom.
items.creator: Jagmeet Singh

items.title: Flock CEO says its microphones detect ‘just gunshots’ — its website says different
items.summary: Langley’s comments come amid mounting scrutiny of Flock from privacy advocates, including the ACLU, and members of the public who are concerned about the misuse of its technology.
items.creator: Aisha Malik
